# Discussions Guide

Welcome to the FingerFlow Studio Discussions! This is the place to connect with other developers and artists in the community.

## Categories

- **General**: Broad questions about the project or sharing cool things you've drawn!
- **Ideas**: Got a crazy idea for a new AI feature or brush? Pitch it here before opening a formal Feature Request.
- **Q&A**: Need help understanding the `CanvasManager` or getting MediaPipe to work on your machine? Ask here!
- **Show and Tell**: Share your custom Brush Plugins or `.ffstudio` templates.

## Rules
- Be kind and respectful.
- Search before asking to see if your question has already been answered.
- Use formatting (code blocks, bold text) to make your posts easy to read.
